fields.summary_ko.0: Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing (TSM) declined approximately 26% from early October high of $487, but assessed as a buying opportunity at undervalued 15.38x next year net income.
fields.summary_ko.1: TSMC showed 59.7% revenue growth year-over-year in October 2026 with robust cutting-edge technology demand, and maintains order stability independent of customer competition with 95% contract manufacturing supply.
